card.name: Misspelled Coadministration at section starts
card.fires_on: The piece 'oad' in the odd spelling 'Coadministration' (C-oad-ministration), seen at the start of a sentence in drug interaction or contraindication sections.

modes.label: Heading-opening sentence
modes.description: 'oad' in 'Coadministration' opening the first sentence under a DRUG INTERACTIONS or CONTRAINDICATIONS heading.
modes.example: 7 DRUG INTERACTIONS C<<oad>>ministration of amiodarone with

modes.label: Table or list entry
modes.description: 'oad' in 'Coadministration' right after a drug name in an interaction table.
modes.example: required in a small number of patients. Riociguat C<<oad>>ministration with fixed-dose abac

card.writes: It promotes odd fragments with no clear link, so there is no clear output effect beyond the word itself.
card.plain: It fires on the middle of the word coadministration when the label starts talking about taking two drugs together.
